events.note: Replay trigger: the May 2024 DONKI event seen above 100 MeV (GOES, at Earth). Dose context: Curiosity RAD measured 8,100 µGy at Mars in the 20 May 2024 event, which DONKI's SEP list does not include.
Compressed: at Jezero the January 2022 regional storm took about 3–4 sols to reach τ ≈ 2 (Lemmon et al. 2022). The demo plays it within minutes.
